format: OGG Vorbis 48 kHz (q4; ambience q3 mono); mono where channels were identical
processing: one-shots: leading silence trimmed, max 4s (risers 6s), peak-normalised to -3 dBFS. ambience: 20s, 1s fades, -35 LUFS. Repo copies: trailing silence below -60 dB trimmed, converted from WAV to OGG.
